geometry.derivationNote: The January 1801 imperial manifesto and RGVIA/RGIA decision record source-verify the legal incorporation of the Georgian Kingdom (Kartli-Kakheti) into Russia. Exact area geometry remains pending reconstruction of its contemporaneous territorial extent from period administrative/cartographic evidence; modern Georgian borders must not be substituted.

territoryChanges.notes: Legal incorporation is source-verified independently of the still-pending historical polygon. This replaces the 1783 protection-status relationship on the russian-legal-border track.

geometry.derivationNote: Alexander I's September manifesto source-verifies the institution of direct internal administration over territory already incorporated earlier in 1801. This administrative transition must not add or redraw the external Russian territory a second time.

territoryChanges.notes: Administrative-state transition only; no second external-border acquisition is implied.
